name: Sori Ayuka
source:
A Humanoid Operating Machine who serves [url=/c41458]Amachi Juichiro[/url] in The Fortress.

[Spoiler]Contains the consciousness of the late [url=/c165799]Aso Yukari[/url], transplanted by Kurushima Michiya.

Taught programming to [url=/c34599]Iriya[/url] and helped her communicate with [url=/c58191]Sub-Con[/url].[/spoiler]
